usage_note: This file contains only what is directly supported by the S21-specific official rule image. It is not a complete S21 board catalog and must not be treated as a full parser configuration.

rules_from_s21_image.魔术师与诡术师交互: 魔术师和诡术师交换的号码完全相同时，则两者均无效。
rules_from_s21_image.定序王子: 放逐投票后定序王子可以翻牌发动技能，重新组织投票。在重新投票前，定序王子可以进行一次额外发言，整局最多使用一次。
rules_from_s21_image.诡术师: 每晚可以交换两个玩家的号码，每个玩家只能交换一次，可以选择不发动技能，不能连续空换。被诡术师交换的玩家白天出局信息置换。

additional_same_season_caption_claims_un.prince_activation: S21 platform AI caption says this applies to exile voting, not sheriff election; after initial vote/tie result, Prince may act before PK speeches; cannot act after PK speech/re-vote.
additional_same_season_caption_claims_un.prince_speech_duration: A 2026-03-20 SRT says 3 minutes; the official image gives no duration.
additional_same_season_caption_claims_un.trickster_night_order: S21 SRT says Trickster acts before meeting the wolf teammates; no night sequence is printed in the official image.
additional_same_season_caption_claims_un.magician_base_skill: S21 captions broadly say the Magician changes night skill resolution, but full ability wording is not in S21-P0105.

unknowns: whether Prince's extra speech has a fixed duration
audio verification of SRT-only tie/PK sequence
